measure: Refunds paid to remote workers who requested 2021 income tax refunds (HB 110)
source: Crain's Cleveland Business, 'City of Cleveland pulls out of COVID income tax refund lawsuit'
verbatim_quote: Cleveland paid out more than $15 million to more than 5,000 remote workers who requested 2021 income tax refunds.

measure: Estimated share (38%) of 2022 refunds paid to people working from home
verbatim_quote: The city of Cincinnati estimates 38% of its 2022 refunds were paid to people working from home, based on analysis by its income tax division. That's $8.6 million out of last year's $22.8 million total.

measure: 2021 remote-work refunds paid Jan 1-June 3, 2022 (plus $124,324 pending 2020 claims); total refunds $3.24M
verbatim_quote: From Jan. 1 to June 3, the city reported about $3.24 million in total refunds. Of that amount, $448,898 from 2021 has been refunded and $124,324 from 2020 would be paid only if the state Supreme Court rules in favor of the refunds.

measure: Refunds attributed to remote work (31% of $1.4M 2022 refunds)
verbatim_quote: That's $431,200 out of the $1.4 million in 2022 refunds paid by the city.
But the city has issued nearly 100 work-from-home refunds this year, worth a combined $163,660, he said.

measure: Refunds to people who worked remotely in 2021, out of ~$319,110 total
verbatim_quote: Out of about $319,110 in total refunds, about $84,187 went to people who worked remotely in 2021.

measure: Remote-work refunds for 2021 (11 refunds), per RITA report; 5 pending 2020 requests $3,864
verbatim_quote: Remote work accounted for 11 refunds totaling $8,304 in 2021 and five pending requests totaling $3,864 in 2020.

measure: About 7 non-resident remote-worker refunds for 2021, of 91 refunds totaling $43,000
verbatim_quote: Of those, about seven went to non-resident, remote workers and amounted to about $8,000.
